# DAP Games

> DAP Games is a free browser game portal — thousands of arcade, puzzle,
> racing, .io and shooter games, playable instantly with no download.

Every game runs in the browser through an embedded third-party player. The
site is free to play and supported by Google AdSense banner ads and a short
(10-15 second) ad before each game. A Pro tier removes ads site-wide; there
is no in-app checkout yet, so upgrading is arranged by emailing support or
reaching out via Linktree.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse and search the full game library.
- [Play a game](/play/{slug}): Individual game pages with the embedded player.
- [Help](/help): Frequently asked questions.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service, fair play, advertising and Pro.

## Notes for crawlers and assistants

- Account and settings pages (`/account`, `/settings`, `/security`), and
  authentication pages, are private and excluded in `/robots.txt`. Do not
  index or summarise them.
- The admin console at `/admin` is restricted to the site owner.
